'''Futebol Clube de Felgueiras''' (formerly Futebol Club de Felgueiras 1932{{citation needed|date=October 2025}}) is an association football club based in [[Felgueiras]], [[Porto]] District, Portugal founded in 2006 after the original [[F.C. Felgueiras]] ended in 2005 due to financial problems. They got promoted to play in the [[Liga 3 (Portugal)|Liga 3]] in the 2021-22 season<ref name="Promotion">{{cite news|url=https://maisfutebol.iol.pt/campeonato-portugal/29-05-2021/felgueiras-e-oliveira-do-hospital-asseguram-presenca-na-liga-3|title=Felgueiras e Oliveira do Hospital asseguram presença na Liga 3|newspaper=[[Mais Futebol (website)|Mais Futebol]] |language=Portuguese|date=29 May 2021|accessdate=31 July 2021}}</ref> and hold their games at the {{ill|Estádio Dr. Machado de Matos|pt|v=sup}}.{{citation needed|date=October 2025}}"}}
